	ability = adm
	allow_multiple = no
	years = 10
	potential = {
		always = no # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
		NOT = { is_dominant_country_of = culture }
	}
	allow = {
		in_civil_war = no
		OR = {

		trigger_if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }

				AND = {
					is_colonial_subject = yes

		}
	}

		monthly_towards_innovative = societal_value_monthly_move
	}
	on_fully_activated = {
		scope:actor = { form_new_culture = yes }
	}
